declaration: Deforms the approved A teacher neutral mesh toward C-adult proportions. NOT an independent mesh; texture and topology inherited unchanged. r02 revisions follow analysis/LEAD_REVIEW_C_R01.md; visual feedback was supplied as text by the lead, no image service was used.
fixes_vs_r01: 1. Head: ONE uniform scale (0.9) for face/eyes/cheeks/ears/skull; r01's ellipsoidal radius falloff (which squeezed the face middle while keeping cheek/skull-back volume) is removed. Transition is placed only at the neck root (y-band with a z-dependent shift so ears stay fully weighted), plus a low-z guard so front-leg columns are never head-scaled.

2. Old belly_tuck removed (it lifted every vert below z~0.1 including hind paws). Replaced by a ground-anchored monotone height map z_new = z + 0.020*smoothstep((z-0.025)/(0.14-0.025)): feet stay, knees/hocks rise, chest and hips get the full +0.020, everything above the shoulder keeps +0.020. Monotone z remap keeps knee/hock fold lines; x/y of legs untouched so legs are not straightened.
3. All four feet grounded individually by spatial cluster (not global minZ). Source hind +x foot rests 1.70mm high; it is lowered 1.70mm with a smooth height fade, other feet already at 0.
Chest/waist x-narrowing and torso y-stretch now carry a low-z guard so paws/feet columns are excluded; torso stretch damped 1.10 -> 1.05 (conservative).
r01 ear elongation (1.15) dropped: ears share the same uniform 0.9 head scale per lead point 1.
feedback_inputs: analysis/LEAD_REVIEW_C_R01.md (lead visual review of r01 renders, applied as text)
region_anchors_source: worker/C-template/r02/probe_r02.json (measured from teacher GLB vertices this revision)

head.center_source: measured: probe_r02 head p50 incl. ears (r01 center -0.008,-0.15,0.222 close; kept measured value)
head.scale_source: lead direction: one consistent conservative scale ~0.9 for the whole head incl. ears, instead of r01 measured per-axis 0.75/0.8/0.82 with radius falloff

neck_transition.note: At upper head height use full head weight; interpolation only at lower neck. See template_fit.py corrected upper-head mask.
neck_transition.source: measured + lead: transition only at neck root

head.leg_guard_source: measured: head bottom (jaw) ~0.168-0.175, front-leg columns share y<-0.11 below that; guard zeroes head weight on leg verts

deformation.muzzle_push_source: inferred: C read has a longer muzzle; kept small (r01 0.008) so face relations dominate

torso_stretch.source: inferred, damped from r01 1.10 (measured length ratio 1.126); z-guard keeps paws fixed in y

chest_width_factor.source: inferred: C slimmer chest relative to head; z-guard excludes feet

waist_width_factor.source: inferred: C side waist tuck; z-guard excludes hind paws (r01 let the waist band reach them in x)

height_lift.formula: z_new = z + lift_max * smoothstep((z - z_start) / (z_full - z_start))
height_lift.source: lead-provided starting map; ground-anchored so paw soles stay, chest/hip and everything above z_full rise the full 2cm, knee/hock rise progressively; monotone so fold lines survive

foot_grounding.source: lead: check four soles separately, never let torso ops touch feet; measured hind_pos_x sole at z=0.00170, other three at 0

inherited_unchanged: no armature in source; static mesh only
pose: static neutral standing, four soles on z=0; no animation exported
not_claimed: no aesthetic adoption score; lead reviews renders, GLM cannot view images in this task
implementation_note: Use template_fit.py with the three lead code corrections; source GLB hash is checked. This profile is fitted to the supplied A, not arbitrary cats.
